headlines.text: It was 2022 when the AEW World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Jon Moxley vs. Penta El Zero M went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.51. Penta El Zero M was challenging for gold for the very first time. A hard-fought battle for the gold.
Flash back to 2024, when FTR vs. LFI (Dralistico & Rush) crossed paths for the first time ever, topping the bill that night on Collision, rated 7.35 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.
That Wednesday in 2022, Castagnoli & Yuta kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.91.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2022: Cash Wheeler reached a real marker of consistency: their 50th match in AEW, facing Swerve in our Glory vs. FTR on Dynamite, rated 7.67 ? a well-worked match in a hard-hitting tag team clash.
Flash back to 2022, when it marked the first-ever meeting between Bryan Danielson and Sammy Guevara on Dynamite, rated 7.34 ? a strong outing.
Flash back to 2024, when Penelope Ford made their long-awaited return to AEW television after 2 years away, appearing on Collision.
